name: Bristol 1350

categories.label: Had the plague (symptoms reached 6+ at any time)
categories.hint: Two Symptom cards totalled 6 or more at any point, or holds the Plague alms card (unless Cured)

categories.label: Escaped on an all-healthy cart
categories.labelVi: Thoát trên xe toàn người khỏe
categories.hint: Your cart crossed the finish line first with nobody plagued on it. Point system: 2 pts each

categories.label: Plagued: stopped every healthy cart
categories.labelVi: Người nhiễm bệnh: chặn mọi xe khỏe
categories.hint: You were plagued and no healthy cart escaped (each crossing cart was empty or carried a plagued player). Point system: 1 pt each

roles.label: Healthy villager
roles.winCondition: Be on the first cart to cross the finish line with no plagued player aboard

roles.label: Plagued villager
roles.winCondition: Make sure every cart that crosses is empty or carries a plagued player, so no healthy player wins

winCondition: Carts reveal everyone's health on crossing. A cart with any plagued player dies and play continues. The first cart that crosses all-healthy ends the game and its players win. The 2nd and 3rd carts must escape in the round after the first non-empty cart crosses or they die. If healthy players cannot win, the plagued players win by blocking them.

endCondition.description: Game ends when an all-healthy cart escapes (healthy win) or no healthy cart can escape (plagued win)

notes: family: hidden-role-race. 1-3 player games add Ghosts (extra non-player villagers that win with all players losing if an all-Ghost cart escapes healthy); in a solo game getting the plague loses. Optional point system for multi-game sessions: healthy escapers 2 pts, plagued blockers 1 pt (modelled as optional categories). Alms card Cured/Plague and character abilities are optional modes.
